verdict.rationale: Linear's evidence documents customer requests: linking feedback to issues, filtering by customer, syncing attributes from Intercom, and routing Slack Asks. None of it shows a product manager replying to the customer from within the feedback record to close the loop. Front and Intercom integrations are adjacent intake and sync features, not documented outbound replies.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop
